WRITTEN BY scripts/agricharts-sweep.mjs (run 36953430878) from their own cashgrid board at https://fsgrain.agricharts.com/markets/cashgrid.php. locationId 85904 is the l= parameter on this location's own chart links, which every row of every AgriCharts board carries; it is NOT the section heading, which is a display name and can be re-typed. At the time of writing this location showed 13 row(s) in Corn, Soybeans.

identityAlternative: this board publishes a BASIS and the NAME of the CBOT contract it is against — writeBidCell(-34, ..., quotes['ZCZ26']) — and the browser adds them up. We do the same arithmetic from the same quote pages, which means cash - basis = futures is true by construction here and would be checking our own subtraction against itself. lib/board.mjs refuses such a source unless it names what it publishes on instead AND every row carries that stamp. The checks that CAN fail all passed before this file was written: the named contract is one our quote pages price, its root agrees with the board's own commodity heading, and every delivery code appears in its own table's column headers.

Company, branch, town, state, ZIP and phone are copied verbatim from data/known-elevators.json. Website is the site the sweep was pointed at. 2026-10-01: lat/lon set to null by hand. The board's own label names two towns (Elburn and Morris, about 45 miles apart) for one bid, and the sweep had pinned it at Elburn. A coordinate for one of two towns is a guess, so it is read and published and kept off the distance map.

COORDINATE (2026-10-02): the operator's own, as published for location 85904 in https://fsgrain.agricharts.com/inc/cashbids/cashbids-js.php (2N374 Meredith Rd, Maple Park, IL, 60151). Filled by scripts/agricharts-published.mjs only because the manifest had none and the published state agrees.
publicNote: Their publicly posted cash board, read from the mobile page their own site serves. Cash and basis are their own commercial numbers. This platform publishes no futures price at all, so none is republished; the futures quote is used only to check that the two columns were read correctly.
_pending: cashRounding is round-cent-either: nearest cent, tie-break not established. Measured across 6,228 rows on 45 captured boards: -0.5, -0.25, +0.25, +0.5 and nothing else, so the interval is closed at both ends. lat/lon was NOT derived here: it is the coordinate geocodes/places.json already holds for CHS - Elburn/ Morris, IL, at street precision via barchart. This location came from a sibling list on a board this repository already reads, and it has no ZIP in data/known-elevators.json -- which is why the coordinate is carried in rather than looked up.
